verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms a keyless, publicly served OpenAPI 3.1 spec (FastAPI, ~405 paths including /v1/auth/*, /v1/users/*, /v1/apple-messages/*) with Swagger UI at /docs, so a machine-readable API surface exists. However, it appears to be the app's own backend/bridge API rather than a supported public developer API: no developer program, public API keys, or usage docs are documented, and llms.txt only describes chat surfaces (macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp, email). Missing for 10: an officially supported public API with documented auth/API keys, developer guides or reference beyond the raw spec, stability/support commitments, and independent or hands-on evidence of driving jo programmatically.
